description: This PHP class 'EmployeePersonalDetailController' manages the presentation logic for employee personal details in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base controller and utilizes various services to prepare data and configuration for rendering the employee personal details component, including permissions and nationality data.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling employee personal detail views, including data preparation and permission setup.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the NationalityService instance.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with employee data, configuration props, nationalities, and permissions for rendering the personal details view.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups relevant for capability/permission checks, specifically 'personal_information'.
